description.ja: Figure-rise Standard セル(完全体)がパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
description.en: Figure-rise Standard cell (complete) is now available with a renewed package! !

description.ja: • セルVS悟飯の対決を再現！
description.en: • Recreate the showdown between Cell VS Gohan!

description.ja: • かめはめ波（溜め・放出）のエフェクトパーツも付属。
description.en: • Effect parts for Kamehameha (storage and release) are also included.

description.ja: • パーツ裏打ちでセルの特徴的な模様を再現！細密な設計と造形によりキャラクターの肉体を自然な造形で再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the cell's characteristic pattern by lining the parts! The character's body is reproduced in a natural shape through detailed design and modeling.

description.ja: • 強靭な筋肉パーツを組み合わせることで、ドラゴンボールのキャラクターの鍛え抜かれた肉体を自分の手で作り上げることができる、新たなプラモデル構築システムだ!!
description.en: • A new plastic model construction system that allows you to create the well-trained body of a Dragon Ball character with your own hands by combining strong muscle parts!!

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ×4（左右こぶし、左右開き手）
accessories.en: Hand parts x 4 (left and right fists, left and right open hands)

accessories.ja: 必殺技エフェクト×2（かめはめ波溜め、放出）
accessories.en: Special move effect x 2 (Kamehame wave storage, release)

accessories.ja: 必殺技エフェクト用台座×1
